title_en: Fall 2026 Course Registration Change and Cancellation
summary: Students changing or cancelling Fall 2026 course registrations must read the attached guides and act within the stated periods. Over-quota requests for undergraduate courses offered by the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering must be submitted from 1 September to 3 September 2026, 18:00, and duplicate course registration requests from 1 to 9 September 2026. Students on military leave taking remote classes must request changes on Jangbyeong e-Eum (장병e음) by 17 September 2026, and course classification changes and grading option selections for other departments' major courses must be completed by 23 September 2026.
applies_to: Students who wish to change or cancel their Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기) course registrations. Specific items apply only to: students requesting over-quota registration for undergraduate courses offered by the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기·정보공학부); students dropping courses that require approval to drop; students requesting duplicate course registration; students on military leave taking remote classes; students changing a course's classification; and students choosing the grading method for major courses of other departments. The notice does not limit these by program, year of admission or nationality.

dates.what: Over-quota registration request period, only for undergraduate courses offered by the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering (deadline strictly enforced)
Deadline for students on military leave taking remote classes to request a course registration change on Jangbyeong e-Eum (장병e음)
Deadline for course classification change registration and approval (one-quarter point of class days)
Deadline for students to apply in mySNU for the grading option selection for major courses of other departments (one-quarter point of class days)

conditions: The general course registration change and cancellation period is not stated in the notice text; it appears to be given in the attachments, which were not read.
The separate over-quota request period applies only to undergraduate courses offered by the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering.
The over-quota request deadline of 3 September 2026, 18:00 is strictly enforced.
For courses that require approval to drop, students must check and submit the drop request within the period.
Students requesting over-quota registration must know the periods and methods for the request, instructor approval and registration confirmation stages.
Students on military leave taking remote classes must request the change themselves on Jangbyeong e-Eum.
Students must apply for the grading option selection themselves in mySNU.
steps: Read the attachments to this notice (Attachments 1-1 to 5); their content was not read, so this summary does not cover it.
Over-quota request: Read the must-read notice at https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57915 and Attachment 2-1 (Quota Exceeding Course Registration Request Manual for Students).
Over-quota request: Learn the periods and methods for request, instructor approval and registration confirmation, and submit the request between 1 September and 3 September 2026, 18:00.
Course drop: Check whether your course requires approval to drop, read Attachment 2-2 (Course Drop Manual for Students), and submit the drop request within the period.

Duplicate course registration: Following Attachment 5, apply via Academic Information [학사정보] > Classes/Grades [수업/성적] > Classes [수업] > Duplicate Course Registration [중복수강신청] between 1 and 9 September 2026.
Military leave remote classes: Request the course registration change yourself on Jangbyeong e-Eum (장병e음) by 17 September 2026.
Course classification change: Following Attachment 3, complete the course classification change registration and approval by 23 September 2026.

Grading option selection: Check the course list at https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LNFU7Q_X_-RghkrtJ7WMsVyIdXdCHBAcbiGJ5xqcphg/edit?usp=sharing, read Attachment 4, and apply yourself in mySNU by 23 September 2026.
translation:
Title: Fall 2026 Course Registration Change and Cancellation (2026학년도 2학기 수강신청 변경 및 취소 안내)

We announce the course registration change and cancellation schedule for Fall 2026. Please refer to the attachments for details.

1. Course registration change and cancellation period
(The period itself is not stated in the notice text; it appears to be in the attachments, which were not read.)
※ For undergraduate courses offered by the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기·정보공학부) only, the over-quota request period is run on a separate schedule*. Please take care not to make mistakes.
* Over-quota request period for undergraduate courses: 2026.09.01. (Tue) to 09.03. (Thu) 18:00 (deadline strictly enforced)
[Must read] https://ece.snu.ac.kr/community/academics?md=v&bbsidx=57915

2. Points to note
1) [Course drop] For courses that require approval, students must check and submit the drop request within the period.
2) [Over-quota request] Students must familiarise themselves with the periods and methods for request, instructor approval and registration confirmation.
3) [Duplicate course registration] Apply via Academic Information [학사정보] > Classes/Grades [수업/성적] > Classes [수업] > Duplicate Course Registration [중복수강신청] (refer to the manual), 9/1 (Tue) to 9/9 (Wed).
3) [Remote classes during military leave] Students must themselves request the course registration change on Jangbyeong e-Eum (장병e음) by 2026.09.17. (Thu).
4) [Course classification change] Course classification change registration and approval must be completed by 2026.09.23. (Wed), the one-quarter point of class days.
5) [Grading option selection for major courses of other departments (타 학과(부) 전공 교과목 성적평가방법 선택제)] Students must apply themselves in mySNU by 2026.09.23. (Wed), the one-quarter point of class days.
Check the course list ▶ https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LNFU7Q_X_-RghkrtJ7WMsVyIdXdCHBAcbiGJ5xqcphg/edit?usp=sharing

Attachment 1-1. Fall 2026 Course Registration Change and Cancellation Guide
Attachment 1-2. Fall 2026 Course Registration Change Summary Notice
Attachment 2-1. (For students) Over-Quota Request Manual
Attachment 2-2. (For students) Regular Semester Course Drop Manual
Attachment 3. Guide to Course Classification Change and Retake Classification Correction
Attachment 4. Guide to Grading Option Selection for Major Courses of Other Departments
Attachment 5. Duplicate Course Registration Manual

Attached files (7): the seven PDF files listed above (Attachments 1-1, 1-2, 2-1, 2-2, 3, 4 and 5). The content of the attachments was not read and is not included in this translation.
